## Session Brief

* [S-D1: design the systematics weights](S-D1.md) - Design only: the typed request and artifact version 15, the per-event weight calculation mirroring MadGraph's systematics.py, the exact header and <rwgt>/<mgrwt> format, PDF loading at scale, refusals, migration, gates and the M3 banking request.
* [S-F1: systematics weights for unmatched events](S-F1.md) - Implement the approved design's S-F1 scope: the typed request at artifact version 15, the PDF member metadata cascade, the weight function and record, MadGraph's exact header and weight format, and the per-event gate on the twelve banked runs.
* [S-F2: systematics weights for MLM events, and S-F1's FA and FE](S-F2.md) - LoRecord from the MLM Rewgt record, <mgrwt> on matched events, the matched refusal lifted; n_qcd from the clustering graph under a dynamical scale (FA); <MGRunCard> on every use_syst sample (FE).
* [S-V1: the CMS-arguments gate, the MLM gates in CI, and FG](S-V1.md) - Gate the 926-weight CMS runs per event and on the banked header; make MadGraph's default-argument MLM runs a CI gate; fix the dump test's unmatched branch; explain or fix the permuted-P1 record differences (FG); measure memory and time on the 880 members.
* [S-V2: the permuted-event flavour code, the xqcut_only branch, and FG's close](S-V2.md) - Fix the production <pdfrwt> flavour code on permuted-P1 MLM events (ttx); make the dump test's unmatched branch correct, with diagnostics; classify ll_0j2j's permuted events under H1; hand the M3 a final re-run.

## Session Report

* [S-D1 report: the systematics weights designed](S-D1-report.md) - The design concept events/systematics-weights.md; MadGraph's own write_banner reproduces the banked header byte for byte and a get_lo_wgt prototype every one of 17.4M banked weights at MadGraph's printed digits; the controls' blind spots; the nominal-first crash that shapes M3; open choices O1-O12, brief corrections and Found.
* [S-F1 report: systematics weights for unmatched events](S-F1-report.md) - The typed request at artifact version 15, YAML metadata with the member cascade, lo_weight over the <mgrwt> record, MadGraph's header and weight bytes, the generation path; every one of 17.4M banked weights within one unit of MadGraph's eighth digit, the header byte-identical from three entry points, the controls as the design predicts.
* [S-F2 report: systematics weights for MLM events, FA and FE](S-F2-report.md) - <mgrwt> on matched events from rewgt, the matched refusal lifted, n_qcd from the clustering graph, <MGRunCard> under use_syst; MadGraph's own systematics.py (with LHAPDF) runs on vibegraph's files and agrees on every weight, vibegraph reproduces MadGraph's module on all 5.88M weights of the four banked MLM runs, the dump-based record check written but not runnable here, and an event-file replay of the banked records in its place.
* [S-V1 report: the CMS-arguments gate, the MLM gates in CI, and FG](S-V1-report.md) - LHAPDF's yaml-cpp re-emission of SetDesc explains the CMS header hash; the header is byte-identical from the bundled .info files and from generate; every one of 37.04M CMS weights is MadGraph's string; MadGraph's default-argument MLM runs gated in the banked layer; the dump test's unmatched branch rewritten for the M3; FG narrowed (not the forests, not the channel search) but not settled; 3.76 GB peak RSS for the 880 members.
* [S-V2 report: MadEvent's chain-head slot, the xqcut_only labels, H1 on ll_0j2j](S-V2-report.md) - The ttx flavour codes are MadEvent's, not ours: the record's chain head is an ipdgcl slot filled for the first call's graph and read after rewgt's own clustering, so under H1 it holds another point's flavour (219 ttx, 19 ll_0j2j events); production writes the event's own flavour and is unchanged. The xqcut_only labels follow unwgt.f's flip on P1 (IMIRROR). ll_0j2j's 77 events are H1; permuted events are now gated unless H1 moved the first call. Merge of #82.
